findings.source: MapleSkyStrategy.sol:144-147 require(IPSMLike(newPsm_).gem() == fundsAsset_, "MSS:SPSM:INVALID_GEM"); require(IPSMLike(newPsm_).usds() == usds_, "MSS:SPSM:INVALID_USDS"); require(IGlobalsLike(globals()).isInstanceOf("PSM", newPsm_), "MSS:SPSM:INVALID_PSM")
findings.issue: In this unoptimised build every call buffer and revert payload starts exactly at the value just stored into mem[64], yet '_46 + ceil32(return_data.size) - mem[64]' is not folded to 0 one line after 'mem[64] = ceil32(return_data.size) + mem[64]'; so usds(), mapleGlobals(), isInstanceOf('PSM', newPsm_) and operationalAdmin() lose their names and arguments, and the three require messages are visible only as hex words. The first call of each chain (gem(), at mem[mem[64]]) is decoded.
findings.rule: This is the simplest form of the P2 root cause: after 'mem[64] = e' and no other store to word 64, a read of mem[64] is e; folding it gives constant offsets from _46 and lets the existing call / Error(string) decoding apply.

notes: Unoptimised build (optimizer off), no loops in the source or in the text. All 31 functions were reviewed: the getters and globals lookups in full, the admin functions (deactivateStrategy, setPsm, setStrategyFeeRate, impair / reactivate), fundStrategy (0x11a5ffad), withdrawFromStrategy and the upgrade / migrate path by structure: nonReentrant (locked 1 / 2), whenProtocolNotPaused (isFunctionPaused(msg.sig), printed with call.func_hash), onlyProtocolAdmins (poolDelegate, governor, operationalAdmin), the StrategyState enum check (Panic(33) for > 2), the PSM / savings-USDS calls, approvals and events; all correct. The storage block leaves savingsUsds, lastRecordedTotalAssets, strategyFeeRate and strategyState as stor5..stor9 (their getters are not in the signature database). Selectors stored as 4-byte slices print in decimal (157198259 = approve).
summary: Faithful and loop-free; readability is dominated by the free-memory-pointer problem in its simplest form (68 P2 lines and require messages left as raw memory).
